info.title: PayU Hosted Checkout API
info.description: API specification for PayU Hosted Checkout where payment method selection and card details are captured on PayU's side.

post.description: Process a payment using PayU Hosted Checkout. For Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) transactions, use the UDF fields and lrs_service_type as described in parameter descriptions.

key.description: Merchant key provided by PayU during onboarding.

txnid.description: The transaction ID is a reference number for the transaction.

amount.description: The payment amount for the transaction.

productinfo.description: A brief description of the product.

firstname.description: The first name of the customer.

surl.description: The success URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to after a successful payment.

furl.description: The Failure URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to after a failed payment.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

hash.description: The hash calculated by the merchant for secure transactions.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

lastname.description: The last name of the customer.

address1.description: This parameter must contain door number, street and area part of customer address.

state.description: This parameter must contain state part of customer address.

country.description: This parameter must contain country part of customer address and must be "IN" (for India).

zipcode.description: This parameter must contain zip or PIN code part of customer address.

buyer_type_business.description: This parameter is used to identify whether it is a business-to-business transaction.

lrs_service_type.description: The LRS service type determines the TCS (Tax Collected at Source) rate based on the nature of the cross-border transaction. Accepted values: education_loan, education_non_loan, medical, travel, others.

curl.description: The Cancel URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the customer cancels the payment.

udf1.description: The Permanent Account Number (PAN) of the customer. Mandatory for LRS transactions as per RBI guidelines.

udf2.description: User-defined field 2 for storing additional information about the transaction.

udf3.description: Date of Birth of the customer in DD-MM-YYYY format. Mandatory for LRS transactions as per RBI guidelines.

udf4.description: Passport Number of the customer. Mandatory for international transactions under LRS.

udf5.description: Purpose Code for the remittance as per RBI LRS guidelines. For example, S0305 for education-related payments.

adddress2.description: This parameter must contain any other part of address, which was not included in address1.

200.description: Successful response - Customer will be redirected to payment page

400.description: Bad request - Request parameters are invalid
